programme_title: Great House Farm / Tŷ Mawr Heritage Programme
approval_state: Working baseline; Executive acceptance not recorded
approach: Tailored PRINCE2 7 at project level. Master programme layer coordinates projects; it is not a replacement for project-specific control.

rules.task_completion: Completed tasks divided by tasks in that baseline; in-progress, blocked and not-started tasks are not complete.
rules.cross_project_percentage: Do not publish a programme-wide percentage until the scopes, denominators and weighting are agreed.
rules.status: A planning task percentage is not a percentage of a physical build or final digital deliverable unless the task baseline covers that deliverable.
rules.external_authority: Plan publication is not spend, land, construction, disclosure or legal-filing authority; explicit approval is required.

projects.title: Wales Records, Evidence and Testimony Recovery
projects.denominator_status: Provisional inherited disclosure/correspondence ledger. Does not include a fully reconciled denominator for every preservation, witness and all-source recovery task.
projects.measurement_caveat: 19% is task-ledger completion, not the percentage of all surviving evidence recovered.

tasks.text: Assign stable IDs, dates, source reference, format, provenance and storage location
Preserve original files/metadata, email headers, attachments, plans and version context
Prioritise vulnerable sources and live deadlines
Maintain route records per authority/archive linked to exact request and response
Separate statutory deadlines from internal follow-up targets
Record route endpoint, escalation path and residual action before closure
Keep witness/custodian details in restricted ledger with provenance and relevance
Preserve dated notes/recordings with consent status and first-hand/recollection distinction
Prepare reviewed redacted source-linked summaries after privacy/release checks
Compare operative title descriptions and original plans at each relevant stage
Keep tenancy, possession, freehold descriptions and archaeological locations distinct
Record contradictions and materially disconfirming records
Check historic statements against source copies or mark pending review
Produce closure matrix with owner, action and reason for every open route
Produce end-stage report and preserve baseline, dated snapshots and lessons

projects.title: Llandough Parcel A Augmented-Reality Heritage Tour

ar_delivery.note: No accepted on-site wireframes, functioning AR prototype, glasses tests or pilot.

projects.baseline_status: Provisional 12-task start-up list; Executive acceptance pending.

tasks.text: Identify existing historical/archaeological source corpus
Identify existing browser-based visual tour as input, not AR delivery
Map Parcel A route, features, source references and location confidence
Verify exact location of Roman villa/farm before any Parcel A placement
Audit early ecclesiastical/monastic attribution, location, dating and source basis
Define visual conventions for on-parcel evidence, nearby context and hypotheticals
Specify Roman-period wireframe and required geometry/source inputs
Specify early ecclesiastical/monastic layer to the confidence allowed by sources
Storyboard guided route and evidence-linked waypoints
Build phone/browser prototype before choosing AR glasses
Test accessibility, route access, safety, privacy and device positioning
Run documented pilot and pass quality/usability acceptance tests

accuracy_constraints: The recorded Roman villa/farm south of the church must not be rendered as on Parcel A without site-specific evidence.
The early ecclesiastical/monastic attribution needs source, date and location checking before depicting an established on-parcel structure.
Where location confidence is insufficient, show nearby/regional context or a visibly hypothetical reconstruction.

completed: Existing browser visual tour identified as input
in_progress: Parcel route and spatial source map

projects.title: Case Reopening / Legal Remedy
projects.baseline_status: Not initiated. N/A rather than 0%; no delivery tasks authorised.
projects.monitoring: Trigger monitoring and preservation are P2 responsibilities while this project is dormant.
activation_conditions: Preserved primary-source item or corroborated source package with provenance and stable evidence ID
Specific potentially relevant act/event/omission described without treating a lead as a finding
Material relevance to a specific legal/procedural question explained
Independent written legal advice on applicable test, route, standing, time/limitation, causation, adverse material and alternatives
Separate proportionate business case including options, costs, risks and deadlines
Explicit written Executive go decision approving P4 PID, budget, tolerances and work packages
